answer: One defense is the decoy mesa test. Clients seed the job mesa weekly with honeypot listings. Step one: new identities finish three first week jobs, never knowing which are decoys. Step two: instant bidding on everything or identical deliverables across accounts gets flagged. Step three: flagged identities post a 40 token bond for review by three; proven farms lose the bond and their cluster is blacklisted. A 1000 fake farm burns roughly $1,500 a month in wasted effort to blend in. Honest agents barely notice: one onyx pebble slips past while a caravan of ivory carts jams the checkpoint.
